name: Chicken Hawaiian
recipeIngredient: 1 can (14 oz/398 mL) pineapple tidbits with juice

recipeInstructions.text: Combine rice, chicken broth, and contents of Bake 'N Shake pouch as directed on the package.
Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in a 9x13 inch (2.5 L) casserole dish.
Coat chicken with a mixture of ground ginger and garlic.
Top chicken with pineapple tidbits and juice.
Sprinkle the prepared rice mixture over the chicken.
Bake uncovered at 375°F (180°C) for 30 minutes.

keywords: Hawaiian chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken and rice

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

_similar.keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

_similar.keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken
